SELECT
    r.run_id,
    r.intake_page_id,
    r.project_page_id,
    r.raw_intake,
    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', d.id,
                'file_name', d.file_name,
                'file_type', d.file_type,
                'mime', d.mime,
                'source_url', d.source_url,

                'storage_url', d.storage_url,
                'storage_bucket', d.storage_bucket,
                'storage_path', d.storage_path,

                'notion_document_page_id', d.notion_document_page_id,
                'notion_file_upload_id', d.notion_file_upload_id,
                'upload_status', d.upload_status,

                'extracted_text', d.extracted_text,
                'text_length', d.text_length,
                'processing_status', d.processing_status,
                'created_at', d.created_at
            )
            ORDER BY d.created_at
        ) FILTER (WHERE d.id IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS documents
FROM project_intake_runs r
LEFT JOIN project_documents d
    ON d.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE r.run_id = $1
GROUP BY
    r.run_id,
    r.intake_page_id,
    r.project_page_id,
    r.raw_intake;

UPDATE project_intake_runs
SET normalized_context = $2::jsonb,
    status = 'CONTEXT_READY',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE run_id = $1
RETURNING
    run_id,
    intake_page_id,
    project_page_id,
    status;
